title: Kerala appoints Ramesh Babu as senior standing counsel for Supreme Court; four appointed standing counsel
description: The State of Kerala has created the post of Senior Standing Counsel in the Supreme Court for the first time, appointing advocate Ramesh Babu to the role.The decision comes after the Congress party came to power in State following the 2026 assembly elections. The State Cabinet also decided to appoint four standing counsel to represent Kerala before the Supreme Court.
